lead: Cinematic film still, bare grey concrete brutalism in bright fog, faint crimson accents.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Custom Dismount.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Custom Dismount-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Custom Dismount-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: range
images.prompt: A world of grey concrete cubes, cylinders, ramps and slabs arranged into hazards under a bright fog.

images.name: profile
images.prompt: A faceless grey mannequin standing alone in a concrete room, lit like a police lineup.

images.name: fall
images.prompt: An empty flight of concrete stairs in fog, a plain grey shop mannequin lying crumpled at the bottom.

images.name: case
images.prompt: A manila case file lying open on a grey concrete table, a single photograph clipped to it.

images.name: archive
images.prompt: Long rows of grey filing cabinets in a quiet concrete archive, one drawer open.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A tired person in an office chair at night, leaning back and exhaling, a monitor glowing grey.

images.name: train
images.prompt: A boxy grey train rushing past an empty concrete metro platform in fog.

images.name: final
images.prompt: A katana blade frozen mid-swing in slow motion, droplets hanging in the air.

images.name: dossier
images.prompt: A wall of surveillance photographs and red string in a grey concrete room.

images.name: concrete
images.prompt: Close-up of a cracked grey concrete wall with a dark crimson stain running down it.
